items.t: Front lower ball joints can wear out and separate
items.note: Price is for both sides plus an alignment. Recall 99V-069 covers affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission case bolt can fall out
items.note: Free under recall 99V-227. Check the VIN. Cost rises a lot if the transmission was damaged.

items.t: Automatic transmission wear and failure
items.note: A used or rebuilt unit costs less than a new dealer unit.

items.t: Second gear can overheat and break
items.note: Recall 04V-176 adds a cooler line fix and replaced damaged units. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver air bag inflator can rupture
items.note: Free under recalls 20V-026 and 20V-027. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High-risk driver air bag inflator (do not drive)
items.note: Free under recall 15V-320. Do not drive; Acura dealers can arrange a tow. Check the VIN.

items.t: Power steering hose can crack and leak onto the exhaust
items.note: Free under recalls 08V-091 and 12V-222 for affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Windshield wipers stop working
items.note: Free under recall 08V-092 for affected cars. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine can stall from a failing fuel pump relay
items.note: Free under recall 07V-097. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear tires wear out very quickly
items.job: Correct rear alignment per service bulletin
items.note: Does not include new tires. Ask the dealer whether bulletin 05-050 / 05-076 was done.

items.t: Torque converter shudder
items.note: Bulletins 16-033 and 16-036 gave extended coverage. Ask the dealer. A software update fixes some cars.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.note: Ask the dealer about Acura's warranty extension and keep top-up records. Many owners just add oil.

items.t: Jerky low-speed shifting in the dual-clutch
items.note: Often free under warranty. If software does not help, transmission repairs cost much more.

items.t: Transmission may not go into Park
items.note: Free under recall 14V-779, including a new transmission if needed. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission can shift into neutral on its own
items.note: Free under recall 16V-640. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump loses output
items.note: Recall 19V-060 updates software and replaces the pump if needed. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Connecting rod bearing can wear and seize
items.note: Recall 23V-751 inspects and repairs or replaces the engine for free. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Timing belt teeth can separate
items.note: Free under recall 19V-298, including any engine damage. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine
items.note: Free under recall 21V-215. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger seat weight sensor can crack
items.note: Free under recalls 24V-064 and 26V-332. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake pedal pivot pin may not be secured
items.job: Inspect and secure brake pedal pivot pin (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 25V-391. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Type S engine can stall or lose power
items.note: Free under recall 25V-031. Check the VIN first.
